Subject: Draft OKRs for Q3 & quick QBR agenda — please review

Team,

Attached is the working draft of Q3 OKRs (Q3_OKR_DRAFT.xlsx) and a suggested QBR agenda (QBR_agenda_v1.docx). High level asks:

- Read the OKR sheet and mark any objectives you think are unrealistic from an engineering or GTM standpoint.
- Confirm the single north-star metric for Platform reliability (proposal: p99 tail latency <= 220ms for hosted API).
- Provide one customer story to highlight during QBR — I suggest Veridian Health; their pilot results are compelling.

Deadlines: responses by EOD Monday 2026-07-12 so I can circulate the sign-off deck to Execs Tuesday morning.

Notes on priorities in the doc:
- Reliability & SLA improvements (platform team lead: Marcus)
- Cost-per-token reductions via batching/quantization (lead: Stephanie)
- Expand Dedicated signups in healthcare (lead: Grace)

Thanks — short replies ok. I want this clean for the 7/14 leadership sync.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of GTM Strategy | Redwood Inference

- Agree with p99 target but propose we add a secondary metric: mean token cost per 1k tokens for text gen (target: -18% vs baseline) so Optimize work is measurable.
- On the reliability objective, call out rollback/fallback policies as a success criterion (helps Platform and DRI for incident work).
- I can provide a one-slide cost model for the deck by Monday.

Will flag two technical risks inline in the sheet.

— Stephanie
